t: This is All Hallows-by-the-Tower, an early medieval Anglican church on Byward Street, overlooking the Tower of London. It was once dedicated jointly to All Hallows and the Virgin Mary, and it's sometimes called All Hallows Barking. The clergyman Philip Thomas Byard Clayton, known as Tubby Clayton, is buried here. He founded Toc H, and his connection to this church is why his name is remembered within these walls. It's a place where a very old building and a twentieth-century founder meet, right beside one of London's most famous fortresses.
